fact_text: Almeezan Investment Management, part of the Meezan group, launched Shariah-compliant funds in Pakistan in 1995, when few such investment options existed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The company's CEO said Almeezan's assets under management closed December 2025 at close to PKR 725 billion, which he described as the largest asset manager in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: Almeezan's CEO said the firm positions itself as a professional manager for investors who lack the time or expertise, giving Shariah-compliant access to equity, debt, commodity and money market assets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: According to the CEO of Almeezan, about 45% of the assets under management in Pakistan's mutual fund industry are Shariah-compliant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: According to the CEO of Almeezan, Shariah-compliant products hold about 20 to 25% of bank deposits in Pakistan, a smaller share than in mutual funds.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: According to the CEO of Almeezan, about 65% of the total outstanding Voluntary Pension System pool is held in Shariah-compliant assets, the highest preference among the products he cited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO said the KMI-30 index, the benchmark for Almeezan's Shariah equity fund, beat the KSE-100 in 11 of the 17 years since its launch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The KMI-30 index is drawn from the 30 most liquid companies in the PSX Shariah-compliant KMI-All universe, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO called the belief that Shariah-compliant funds earn less than conventional funds a myth, arguing that each fund delivers the return of its underlying asset class.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: Shariah equity screens exclude companies with heavy interest-bearing debt or a large share of income from interest, so these screened stocks tend to hold up better when volatility rises.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: Two companies in the same sector can differ in Shariah status, for example because one carries heavy interest-bearing leverage or earns much of its income from interest, so each stock is screened separately.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The PSX screens all listed companies against the agreed Shariah criteria and publishes the KMI-All list, which is reviewed about every six months and updated on the exchange website.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: Sukuk must be backed by an identifiable, unencumbered asset, so their supply is limited, unlike conventional government securities such as T-bills and PIBs that can be issued at any time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO said Shariah fixed-income returns have sometimes been below conventional ones because of a demand-supply mismatch, not a structural rule, and expects the gap to narrow as sukuk supply grows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO said government issuers are working on more sukuk structures, which he expects to reduce the shortage of Shariah-compliant fixed-income supply over time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO said the government plans to bring the whole financial system under Islamic finance by about 2028, which he expects will keep adding to Shariah-compliant asset demand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's savings ratio sits in low double digits, against about 25 to 30% in the wider region.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO attributed weak financial inclusion to three links: low incomes, low savings out of those incomes, and low conversion of savings into investment, which leaves a large untapped market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: Companies can move employee provident funds into a Voluntary Pension System, which removes the company's fund management task and lets each employee choose asset allocation within the scheme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: The CEO said the credibility of the Shariah advisor is the single most important factor for many investors, because a typical investor cannot judge Shariah compliance alone.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)

fact_text: A Shariah-compliant commodity fund takes delivery of the underlying gold rather than using leveraged margin positions, so its investors avoid the margin volatility that direct traders face.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Wanted to Know About Shariah-Compliant Investing | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-20)
